goal.insight: Show via parallel coordinates that every car excels in some dimensions but drops in others, making visible the absence of any single model dominating all seven axes simultaneously
Encode seven parallel axes (price, fuel efficiency, power, safety, interior space, resale value, emission rating) with polylines colored by vehicle type: SUV, sedan, and electric

Emphasize how each vehicle type (SUV, sedan, electric) forms distinct band patterns across certain axes — e.g., SUVs cluster high on space but low on fuel efficiency, electrics cluster high on emissions but vary widely on price

Highlight the frequent line crossings between the power and fuel-efficiency axes, showing a prominent trade-off pattern, and note the varied crossings between price and resale-value axes, where brand reliability and demand create unpredictable relationships
Visually distinguish the top-ranked car on each individual axis so viewers can see that different models lead on different dimensions
